newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,134 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,134 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 1,134 contracts, according to the CBOT.
There were 53 wheat contracts, 445 corn, 623 soybean and 13 soymeal futures contracts traded, along with 1 wheat call and 5 soybean call options.
The overnight trend for corn was 3/4 to 1-3/4 cents per bushel higher, soybeans were up 5 to 7-1/2 cents, wheat steady to up 3/4 cent, and soymeal steady to up $2.50 a ton.
